P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder image appears anywhere on the page; it is entirely text and a QR code.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits of any kind on this page.

P07.rationale: No press logos, rating cards, review grid, or testimonials are present anywhere on the page.

P10.rationale: The oversized URL text functions somewhat as a large typographic element, but there are no ghost numerals or decorative quote glyphs as compositional devices.

P11.rationale: No data visualisations, charts, before/after comparisons, or cost-math graphics are present on the page.

P12.rationale: The layout is extremely sparse with only a headline block, a URL, and a QR code, leaving the majority of the sheet empty.

P13.rationale: A dark navy background provides a minimal atmospheric tone, but there is no texture, pattern, or photographic atmosphere beyond the flat colour.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so scrim treatment is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears on the page.

N07.rationale: The page contains no imagery at all beyond a QR code, so generic stock imagery is not an issue, though the absence of specific visuals is itself a weakness.

N08.rationale: Large swaths of the page — roughly the middle third and lower third — are completely empty with no content, creating severe dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: There is no photo background with overlaid text, so no scrim or readability issue exists.
